title: Flatpack Empire command (UI -> engine)
description: PROPOSAL v1. One JSON object per line on the engine's stdin. Every player action the UI can take is listed here; selecting a lane, zone or aisle is UI-local and never sent. The engine answers each command in the next snapshot's commandResults[]. x-status says whether the engine can do it today: 'method exists' means a Java method does the work but no Command class wraps it yet.

id.description: Chosen by the UI, unique per session. Echoed in commandResults[].id.

seenTick.description: The snapshot tick the player was looking at. Informational; the engine records the tick it applied the command at.

pause.description: Pause the simulation. The UI also sends this when it opens the end-of-day modal, and resume when the player dismisses it.
pause.x-roadmap: v4.1 (GameEngine.advance() exits its loop when status leaves RUNNING, so nothing could resume)

multiplier.description: APPROVED_SIM_SPEEDS in GameClock. Rev 2's v4.1 lists 1x/2x/4x; drop 8 here if that wins.

upgrade.x-source: UpgradeManager.upgrade(UpgradeType). UpgradeManager is not constructed in Main and charges nothing yet.

arrivalDay.description: Absolute day; the engine maps it to a manifest slot.

orderStock.x-source: DeliveryManager.scheduleInboundProduct(int arrivalSlot, Product). Nothing calls it today; ProcurementManager is empty.
